strings.8-ФЗ статья 19 часть статьи, устанавлива: 8-FZ Article 19 part of the article establishing partial disclosure
“The statement contains personal data. Access to the entire document is refused.” No reference is given to a legal instrument restricting access.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенной: Author's training summary of the verified provision, not a website copy
strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В одном документе совмещены разные катег: Different access categories are combined in one document.
strings.В открытой копии столбцы скрыты визуальн: The columns are visually hidden in the public copy, but the underlying file allows them to be revealed.
strings.Выдать частные банковские счета и телефо: Release private bank account details and telephone numbers without a legal basis
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Есть общедоступная и ограниченная части: There are public and restricted sections
strings.Есть общие расходы по мероприятиям и отд: There are aggregate expenditures by activity and separate columns for citizens' telephone numbers and accounts.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия работника М: A complaint about a service centre employee's decisions and actions goes to that centre's director. Do not confuse a centre employee with the body providing the service.
strings.Жалобу на решения и действия самого МФЦ: A complaint about the service centre's own decisions and actions goes to its founding authority or an official authorised by a regulatory legal act of the constituent entity.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Закрытая графа делает весь документ непр: A restricted column makes the entire document unavailable for disclosure.
strings.Заменить проверку документов названием и: Replace document verification with the source's name.
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Запрос поступил в орган местного самоупр: The request was received by the local self-government authority holding the required materials. Aggregate expenditure and payment purposes without citizen identifiers are publicly accessible. Certain rows contain private contact and bank details; the case provides no lawful basis for disclosing them to the applicant. No real personal data are used.
The public section of the information was requested.
strings.Запрошены расходы бюджета {{caseYear}} п: The request concerns {{caseYear}} budget expenditure by activity and a description of the work. Citizens' surnames, private telephone numbers and bank details are not requested.
strings.Как мотивирован полный отказ?: What reasons were given for the blanket refusal?
strings.Какой вывод следует из запроса и состава: What follows from the request and the contents of the statement?
strings.Категории доступа различаются внутри док: Access categories differ within the document; the presence of a restricted section does not remove the duty to provide the public section.
The follow-up clarification has been added to the case file.
strings.Любая закрытая графа запрещает предостав: Any restricted column prohibits disclosure of all information in the document.
strings.Можно открыть все реквизиты ради полноты: All details may be disclosed to make the response complete.
strings.Найдите норму и подтвердите её применимо: Find the rule and confirm its applicability to the specific documents in the case.
strings.Найдите положение, которое подходит к ус: Find the provision that fits the established circumstances, not merely the topic of the submission.
strings.Найдите правило предоставления информаци: Find the rule on providing information when access to part of it is restricted.
strings.Найдите часть статьи, устанавливающую по: Find the part of the article that establishes how the publicly accessible portion is provided, and enter its number. Link the rule to the established circumstances.
strings.Направить понятный ответ в надлежащем по: Send a clear response using the proper procedure
Do not withhold aggregate amounts without a legal basis.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Отказать во всех сведениях только из-за: Refuse all information solely because one column is restricted
strings.Отказываем во всём документе без разделе: Refuse the entire document without separating its sections.
strings.Открытая часть: мероприятие, общая сумма: Public section: activity, total amount, type of work. Restricted section under the case facts: individuals' private telephone numbers and bank accounts, with no basis for their disclosure. No real records are included.
strings.Отправить файл: столбцы изначально не ви: Send the file: the columns are not initially visible.
strings.Переадресовать всё в Роскомнадзор вместо: Forward everything to Roskomnadzor instead of answering the budget request.
strings.Передача закрытых реквизитов без основан: Disclosure of restricted details without a legal basis.
strings.Подготовить безопасную копию без передав: Prepare a safe copy that does not transfer restricted values, and check it before release.
strings.Подготовить копию без закрытых реквизито: Prepare a copy without the restricted details
strings.Подготовить ответ самого располагающего: Prepare a response from the authority holding the information: the public section and reasons for excluding the remaining information.
strings.Подготовить открытые сведения и мотивиро: Prepare the public information and reasons for restricting the remainder
strings.Полный отказ не разграничивает части инф: The blanket refusal does not distinguish between the sections of information.
strings.Помощник: «Одна строка ограниченного дос: Assistant: “One restricted row closes off the entire budget document.”
strings.После принятия решения заявителю направл: After the decision, a reasoned reply must be sent to the applicant no later than the following day. This is a separate action, not a new full complaint consideration period.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Предложить заявителю получить согласие к: Suggest that the applicant obtain consent from every recipient of expenditure.
strings.Предоставляется общедоступная часть; огр: The publicly accessible section is provided; restricting the remainder must be justified by a legal instrument.
strings.При наличии общедоступной и ограниченной: Where information has public and restricted parts, provide the public information. Justify restriction of the remainder by the relevant act.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Применимость к конкретной истории устана: Applicability to a particular story depends on its circumstances. A document title alone does not justify the selected action.
strings.Применить правило независимо от обстояте: Apply the rule regardless of the circumstances.
strings.Принятое действие не обеспечивает необхо: The selected action does not ensure the required verification of the result.
strings.Проверить отсутствие скрытых закрытых ли: Check that the copy to be released contains no hidden restricted sheets or internal attachments
strings.Проверить регистрацию и предмет запроса: Check registration and the subject of the request
strings.Проверьте исходное событие и единицы счё: Check the triggering event and counting units. The reply deadline may differ from the deadline for a specific action.
strings.Проверяем части информации и предоставля: Check the information sections and provide publicly accessible information.
strings.Раз документ связан с бюджетом, банковск: Because the document concerns the budget, citizens' bank accounts are public too.
strings.Разделить общедоступные и ограниченные с: Separate publicly accessible and restricted information
strings.Рассчитайте крайний день ответа на зарег: Calculate the deadline for responding to the registered request under 8-ФЗ. No deferral was used; the request concerns this body's activities.
strings.Скрытие отображения не равно исключению: Hiding information from view is not the same as removing restricted information from the file being transferred.
strings.Следует предоставить общедоступную часть: The publicly accessible section should be provided, excluding restricted information and giving the grounds for that restriction.
strings.Сопоставьте выбранный маршрут, полномочи: Compare the selected referral route, powers and plan. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Сохранён самостоятельный ранее поставлен: This is a retained standalone scenario supplied earlier, not a new variant in this release.
strings.Сравните документы: кто их составил, к к: Compare the documents: who prepared them, and which site and issue they concern. Mark only the materials needed for the selected conclusion.
strings.Суммы по мероприятиям программы и описан: Amounts by programme activity and descriptions of completed work, without information on individual recipients.
strings.Только общий порядок жалоб по 59-ФЗ: Only the general complaints procedure under 59-ФЗ
strings.Только фразой «документ содержит персона: Only with the phrase “the document contains personal data”. No specific grounds or public section were provided.
Delete the original statement from the records.
strings.Указать применимое правовое основание ис: State the applicable legal basis for the exclusions.
strings.Уточните обстоятельства, прежде чем поль: Clarify the circumstances before using the solution to a similar case.
strings.Учебная модель органа местного самоуправ: A training model of a local self-government body holding an adopted budget decision. You prepare a response under 8-ФЗ. The simulated publication and documents are fictional; no violation is attributed to a real municipal body.
strings.Частичное предоставление вместо полного: Partial disclosure rather than blanket refusal or unconditional disclosure.
strings.Что в ведомости открыто и что закрыто?: What in the statement is public and what is restricted?
strings.Я просил исполнение бюджета по программе: I asked for budget implementation under the programme and a list of expenditure. They replied that the original statement contains personal data, so nothing can be provided. But I do not need other people's telephone numbers or bank accounts.
